filter.description: A Google Meet API filter expression for this resource collection.

startTime.description: Only records that started at or after this RFC 3339 time, such as 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z. Sent as start_time>="..." and combined with filter by AND.

endTime.description: Only records that started at or before this RFC 3339 time, such as 2026-11-08T00:00:00Z. Sent as start_time<="..." and combined with filter by AND.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of conference records to return.

pageToken.description: A pagination token returned by a previous list call.
